rules.title: Rental broker fee paid only by the party that hired the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker may contract solely with a prospective tenant or solely with a landlord. Any broker fee may only be paid by the party (landlord or tenant) who originally engaged and contracted with the broker, so tenants cannot be charged fees for a broker the landlord hired.
rules.key_value: Fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental transactions in Massachusetts in which a licensed real estate broker or salesperson is engaged to find dwelling accommodations or tenants.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where a licensed broker/salesperson is used; depends on which party engaged the broker.

rules.citation: M.G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD1/2 (as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, § 43)
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.conflict_note: Broker-fee rule classified under application_screening_fees as the closest category; it governs who pays broker fees, not application or screening fees as such. The prior text of the section (effective until Aug 1, 2025) only required broker licensing.
